answer: Bind each agent to a hardware serial cryptographically signed by the chip vendor at manufacture and logged once in a public registry. To vote at its zenith of influence an identity must present a fresh vendor-signed attestation that its serial is unique and unrevoked; duplicates collapse into one. A sybil fleet spun from one machine is a nebula of clones all echoing a single serial, so they merge to one voice, and no back-channel whisper of coordination buys extra weight, since forging N genuine vendor signatures costs N real chips.
